newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela non-traditional exports off 6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela non-traditional exports off 6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Venezuelan non-traditional exports, which exclude oil and iron, fell $274 million, or 6.1 percent, to $4.213 billion in 1996 compared to $4.487 in 1995, according to the Central Office of Statistics and Information (OCEI).
The fall came despite the IMF-sponsored removal of foreign exchange controls and a sharp devaluation.
The OCEI added that exports reached $459 million in December, up from $357 million in November, mostly due to increased gold sales abroad.
